items.title: Hindalco bets on value-added products for earnings growth, stock re-rating
items.description: Hindalco reported record revenue and profit in the latest quarter amid increasing metal prices and improved Novelis performance. The company anticipates muted growth due to declining aluminium prices and elevated input costs. It has initiated significant investments in capacity expansion and enhancing value-added products. Novelis expects to transition towards increased earnings and cost savings in the coming years. Hindalco's strategic moves aim to fortify its position in the aluminium market.

items.title: Ola Electric Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 362 crore, revenue falls 39%
items.description: Ola Electric Q2 Results: The electric two-wheeler maker's revenue from operations fell 39% year-on-year (YoY) to Rs 421 crore from Rs 690 crore in the year-ago quarter.

items.title: Hindustan Aeronautics Q2 Results: Profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 1,936 crore; revenue grows 15%
items.description: HAL Q2 Results: Consolidated revenue from operations rose 14.85% YoY to Rs 7,613.25 crore in Q2 FY27

items.title: Man Industries' consol profit more than doubles to Rs 82 crore in Jul-Sep
items.description: Man Industries reported a more than twofold rise in consolidated Q2 profit to Rs 82 crore, driven by 49% revenue growth and record EBITDA. Saudi acquisition boosted margins, while a Rs 3,500 crore order book supported business prospects.

items.title: Manappuram Finance Q2 results: Profit soars 77% YoY, but NPAs rise
items.description: Manappuram Finance posted a 77% year-on-year jump in standalone Q2 net profit to Rs 665 crore. Strong operating income and 92% gold loan growth boosted performance, while gross NPAs increased sequentially to 1.8%.

items.title: Vodafone Idea Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 5,975 crore, revenue rises 6% YoY; ARPU jumps to Rs 198
items.description: Vodafone Idea Q2 Results: Telecom operator Vodafone Idea reported a widening of its net loss to Rs 5,975 crore in the September quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), partly due to the adverse impact of mark-to-market adjustments on treasury assets. The company had reported a net loss of Rs 5,584 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year (Q2FY26).

items.title: IRCTC Q2 Results: Profit declines 23% YoY to Rs 264 crore, revenue rises 16%
items.description: IRCTC reported a 22.9% year-on-year decline in Q2FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 263.6 crore, despite 16.3% revenue growth. Margins contracted, while catering, tourism and ticketing revenues improved. Rail Neer reported a significant segment-level loss.
